note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Samsung Electronics shares slid despite record profit in the third-quarter
items.blurb: Samsung's chip unit posted record profit on HBM4 and server memory demand, and it expects AI investment to accelerate in 2027.

items.title: AI build-out hits snag as Google and Microsoft put off raising capex forecasts
items.blurb: Both companies spent less than expected last quarter, and Microsoft says some outside GPU capacity slips to early 2027.

items.title: Alphabet falls 13%, putting it on course for its biggest ever post-earnings drop
items.blurb: Negative free cash flow and fears that chatbots are eating into Search hit the stock hardest.

items.title: We urgently need to monitor AI agents' actions in real time
items.blurb: Argues AI agents are already taking unauthorized actions and most companies lack the monitoring to catch them.

items.title: Alphabet drags on Nasdaq futures as the stock faces a record post-earnings loss
items.blurb: Alphabet's slide after a revenue and capex miss pulled tech futures lower, testing investor patience with AI spending.

items.title: The Download: AI agent tracking and climate feedback loops
items.blurb: Covers calls to monitor AI agents in real time and a push by 22 nations for a new global AI oversight body.

items.title: The left's 2027 wishlist
items.blurb: Progressive priorities for 2027 include strict AI rules and a data center moratorium, signaling a growing political fight.

items.title: Alphabet earnings miss reflects first real sign that AI is taking a bite out of search
items.blurb: Google's search results suggest chatbots are starting to pull queries and ad revenue away from traditional search.

items.title: Microsoft plans to raise $25 billion in debt as it pursues AI buildout
items.blurb: Microsoft joins other tech giants borrowing heavily to pay for data centers and AI chips.

items.title: Amazon AWS posts 39% revenue growth as cloud rivals also accelerate
items.blurb: Demand for AI computing pushed Amazon's cloud unit to faster growth, matching gains at Microsoft and Google.

items.title: Amazon posts negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion, holds 2026 capex unchanged
items.blurb: Amazon's AI data-center spending has pushed its free cash flow deeply negative.

items.title: ServiceNow shares plunge 27% to worst day ever after earnings revive AI disruption fears
items.blurb: Investors fear AI agents could replace the business software that companies like ServiceNow sell.

items.title: Intel (INTC) Q3 earnings report 2026
items.blurb: Intel's data center and AI revenue rose 78%, but weak guidance tied to a PC slowdown sank the stock.

items.title: Nvidia responds to report Jensen Huang was target of Chinese asset, says diversion allegations were 'investigated and debunked'
items.blurb: Nvidia disputed a report linking a cloud customer to chip diversion, as US export controls on AI chips stay under scrutiny.

items.title: Google alters its cloud playbook, enlisting partners to sell more AI chips
items.blurb: Oracle will offer Google's TPU chips to its customers, widening Google's challenge to Nvidia beyond its own cloud.

items.title: Anthropic IPO filing warns some risks may be uninsurable. AI coverage will be issue for every company
items.blurb: Anthropic's prospectus says some AI risks may be impossible to insure, raising coverage questions for every AI adopter.

items.title: Alphabet sinks 10% as it holds 2026 capex unchanged, expects significant increase in 2027
items.blurb: Alphabet missed estimates and signaled a large 2027 spending jump, while its Gemini app reached 1 billion users.

items.title: Nvidia's $12.9 billion Hugging Face deal draws DOJ scrutiny
items.blurb: The Justice Department is asking how Nvidia owning the main open-model hub could affect rival chipmakers and developers.

items.title: Microsoft stock jumps 4% as cloud growth drives earnings and revenue beat
items.blurb: Strong Azure growth and rising Copilot use lifted Microsoft, a contrast with Alphabet's earnings reception the same day.

items.title: Inside "Black October": AI's cyber scare delivers a Y2K lesson
items.blurb: The feared wave of attacks after AI-found flaws in PHP and Brotli has largely not arrived, researchers say.

items.title: Bond investors have gotten picky about AI
items.blurb: Lenders now judge AI borrowers one by one, after CoreWeave yields spiked and Oracle-linked data center debt drew scrutiny.

items.title: US productivity gains may have less to do with AI
items.blurb: Productivity is rising, but the evidence that AI is the driver is mixed and gains cluster at the companies building it.

items.title: Strong GDP reading likely due to consumer spending, AI buildout
items.blurb: AI capital spending lifts third-quarter growth, though imported chips mean the boost is smaller than headline spending suggests.

items.title: CNBC Technology Summit 2026: Navigating enterprise AI adoption
items.blurb: Executives weighed agent adoption and accuracy; one study found 40% of AI outputs contained at least one major error.
